camel_example: aliyun ram UpdateLoginProfile --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordResetRequired true --UserName zhangq0000 --MFABindRequired true --Password mypassword
description_en: Modifies the logon configurations of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 调用UpdateLoginProfile接口修改用户的登录配置
kebab_example: aliyun ram update-login-profile --user-name zhangq0000 --password mypassword --password-reset-required true --mfa-bind-required true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLoginProfile

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM user
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The logon password of the RAM user. The password must meet the password strength requirements
parameters.help_zh: 指定密码，密码必须符合云账号的密码强度要求
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the RAM user has to change the password upon logon
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户在登录时是否需要修改密码
parameters.name: password_reset_required

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether a multi-factor authentication (MFA) device must be bound to the RAM user upon logon
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户在下次登录时是否必须绑定多因素认证设备
parameters.name: mfa_bind_required
